OverviewSections.Heading: Who We Are
OverviewSections.Body: KOR Structural Engineers is a full-service structural engineering firm with offices across North America. Founded on a commitment to technical excellence and client-centred service, we partner with developers, architects, and contractors to deliver innovative, cost-effective structural solutions for residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects of every scale.

OverviewSections.Heading: What We Do
OverviewSections.Body: Our team of licensed professional engineers provides comprehensive structural engineering services across the full project lifecycle — from schematic design and design development through to construction documents, peer review, and construction administration. We specialize in concrete, steel, mass timber, and hybrid structures, and bring creative problem-solving to every challenge.

OverviewSections.Heading: Where We Work
OverviewSections.Body: With offices in Vancouver, Vancouver Island, the Okanagan, Edmonton, and the United States, we serve clients throughout Canada and across North America. Our project portfolio spans high-rise residential towers, mid-rise mixed-use developments, commercial buildings, institutional facilities, and specialized structures.

OverviewSections.Heading: Why KOR Structural
OverviewSections.Body: We pride ourselves on building lasting relationships through responsive communication, collaborative design, and a genuine commitment to structural excellence. Our engineers bring deep expertise and personal dedication to every project — delivering structures that are safe, efficient, and built to last. When you work with KOR, you get a team that cares about your project as much as you do.

People.Name: Islam Shabana
People.Bio: Islam Shabana is a Senior Structural Engineer with extensive experience in the design and analysis of high-rise residential and commercial structures. With a doctorate in structural engineering and professional licensure in Alberta, Islam brings rigorous analytical skills and a deep understanding of complex structural systems to every project. He specializes in concrete and steel structures, seismic design, and the structural assessment of existing buildings.

Blocks.PersonnelBlurb: Our team of experienced engineers and technical professionals is the foundation of everything we do. Each member brings specialized expertise, professional dedication, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional structural engineering.
